نجص (form I)
# نَجُصُّ (najuṣṣu) /na.d͡ʒusˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of جَصَّ (jaṣṣa)
# نُجَصُّ (nujaṣṣu) /nu.d͡ʒasˤ.sˤu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of جَصَّ (jaṣṣa)
# نَجُصَّ (najuṣṣa) /na.d͡ʒusˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of جَصَّ (jaṣṣa)
# نُجَصَّ (nujaṣṣa) /nu.d͡ʒasˤ.sˤa/: first-person plural non-past passive
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
